jobs.occupation: PhD scholarship in Coastal Engineering (Wave-Vegetation Interaction) - DTU Construct
jobs.description:
How can coastal vegetation help protect our coastlines from waves and flooding? Understanding how waves interact with vegetation is key to exploring its potential for coastal protection and climate adaptation. Are you interested in combining fluid mechanics, mathematical analysis and numerical modelling to help answer this question.

Then join us for a 3-year PhD fellowship in coastal engineering at the Technical University of Denmark (DTU), Department of Civil and Mechanical Engineering, Section for Fluid Mechanics, Coastal and Maritime Engineering.

Your PhD research will play an integral part in the project “Marine advection and dissipation in the vegetated coastal environment”, financed by the Independent Research Fund Denmark.

You will collaborate with researchers at DTU and DHI in Denmark, as well as at University College Dublin, Ireland and Northeastern University, USA.

Responsibilities 
Your primary tasks will be to develop analytical and numerical models for waves interacting with coastal vegetation. Particular emphasis will be placed on the wave-averaged flow generated by surface waves and on the changes introduced by vegetation canopies.

The research will include:

• Development and validation of models for wave-induced mean velocity profiles over vegetated beds under regular waves.
• Extension of these models to irregular wave fields, including derivation of wave-averaged shear-stress distributions and mean velocity profiles.
• Investigation of undertow and circulation currents above vegetated beds in the surf zone under breaking waves.
• Development of a cross-shore momentum balance describing wave-induced changes in mean water level and the potential reduction of storm-surge flooding by coastal vegetation.
• Numerical simulations using computational fluid dynamics 
• Application of advanced turbulence models for surface-wave flows, modified to account for vegetation.
• Validation of the developed models against existing high-quality laboratory datasets.
• Development of practical parameterizations suitable for implementation in larger-scale coastal and hydrodynamic models.
The project combines fundamental fluid mechanics with applications directly relevant to coastal protection and climate adaptation. A major scientific objective is to move beyond conventional empirical vegetation models and instead explicitly account for the modification of the wave-induced velocity field within and above vegetation canopies.

Qualifications
We are looking for candidates with a strong background in one or more of the following areas:

• Coastal or ocean engineering
• Fluid mechanics or hydrodynamics
• Computational fluid dynamics
• Environmental hydraulics
• Applied mathematics or a closely related field
Experience with numerical modelling, programming and/or CFD is highly desirable. Experience with turbulence modelling, wave mechanics or coastal hydrodynamics would be advantageous, but is not essential. Strong mathematical skills and an interest in combining theoretical analysis with numerical modelling are important.

You must have a two-year master's degree (120 ECTS points) or a similar degree with an academic level equivalent to a two-year master's degree.

Approval and Enrolment 
The scholarship for the PhD degree is subject to academic approval, and the candidate will be enrolled in one of the general degree programmes at DTU. For information about our enrolment requirements and the general planning of the PhD study programme, please see DTU's rules for the PhD education. 

We offer
DTU is a leading technical university globally recognized for the excellence of its research, education, innovation and scientific advice. We offer a rewarding and challenging job in an international environment. We strive for academic excellence in an environment characterized by collegial respect and academic freedom tempered by responsibility.

Salary and appointment terms
The appointment will be based on the collective agreement with the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations. Please see DTU’s salary structure for scientific staff: www.inside.dtu.dk/en/human-resources/during-employment/salary/salary-structures.

The period of employment is 3 years. Starting date is anticipated as 1 February 2027, or according to mutual agreement. The position is a full-time position. 

You can read more about career paths at DTU here.

Further information 
Further information may be obtained from Professor David R. Fuhrman (drfu@dtu.dk).

You can read more about Department of Civil and Mechanical Engineering at www.construct.dtu.dk.

If you are applying from abroad, you may find useful information on working in Denmark and at DTU at DTU – Moving to Denmark. Furthermore, you have the option of joining our monthly free seminar “PhD relocation to Denmark and startup “Zoom” seminar” for all questions regarding the practical matters of moving to Denmark and working as a PhD at DTU. 

Application procedure 
Your complete online application must be submitted no later than 10 November 2026 (23:59 Danish time). Applications must be submitted as one PDF file containing all materials to be given consideration. To apply, please open the link "Apply now", fill out the online application form, and attach all your materials in English in one PDF file. The file must include:

• A letter motivating the application (cover letter)
• Curriculum vitae 
• Grade transcripts and BSc/MSc diploma (in English) including official description of grading scale
You may apply prior to obtaining your master's degree but cannot begin before having received it. 

Applications received after the deadline will not be considered.

All interested candidates irrespective of age, gender, disability, race, religion or ethnic background are encouraged to apply. As DTU works with research in critical technology, which is subject to special rules for security and export control, open-source background checks may be conducted on qualified candidates for the position.

DTU Civil and Mechanical Engineering develops and utilises science and technical knowledge for the benefit of society and the sustainable development. We undertake research, education, innovation, and scientific advice of the highest quality within building design and processes, building construction and safety, building energy and technical services, solid mechanics, fluid mechanics, coastal and maritime engineering, materials technology, manufacturing engineering, engineering systems design, design for sustainability, and thermal energy.

DTU – For the benefit of society since 1829
DTU is one of Europe's leading elite technical universities. Through research and education at an international top level, we create solutions to the major societal challenges of our time and help secure Europe's global leadership in sustainable technological development. Since Hans Christian Ørsted founded DTU almost 200 years ago, our mission has remained the same: We develop and create value through the natural and technical sciences for the benefit of society. DTU has 13,800 students, 1,600 PhD students, and 6,500 employees. We work in an international environment and have an inclusive, stimulating, and informal work culture. DTU has campuses in all parts of Denmark and in Greenland and collaborates with the best universities around the world.

jobs.occupation: AI Red Team Specialist – Lead Researcher in Agentic Security
jobs.description:
We’re looking for an experienced red teamer with proven credentials in agentic red teaming to join our advanced product and research team.

What you’ll do

You’ll join the team dedicated to building and developing a tool that dynamically tests and evaluates large language models (LLMs) and their native application context for vulnerabilities.

You’ll be working with seasoned reverse engineers, application pentesters, red teamers, and data scientists, bridging multiple digital disciplines by creating a unique suite that gives our clients the capability to test, remediate, and harden their agentic workloads.

What you’ll bring

Most of all, we value ingenuity, curiosity, and drive. You may be a great fit for this role if you have experience with:

• Building or contributing to tools used for dynamic application testing

• Working extensively with open source or proprietary tools used for web and application pentesting

• Actively adopting LLMs and Model Context Protocol (MCP) in automating and enhancing your penetration tests

• Spending time researching agentic vulnerabilities and attending relevant trainings or conferences

To fit right in here at The Tech Collective:

• You should be genuinely curious about new developments within the red teaming domain

• You possess the willingness to tackle new and technical challenges as they arise

• You know how to break down and structure complex assignments and enjoy sharing your knowledge and insights with your team members

• You possess a startup mentality to help drive the innovation and ingenuity of our red team products

• You can cooperate seamlessly with different profiles in a highly diverse team of researchers, developers, consultants, and red teamers

We don’t expect you to know everything – after all, agentic security is a rapidly evolving field! In this role, we’re looking for someone who wants to own, develop, and innovate the product modules related to testing the application context (e.g., API security, cryptographic implementation, broken authentication, RBAC) and supporting infrastructure (e.g., misconfigurations, server-side vulnerabilities) for the agents that we test.

To succeed in this role, your experience and competencies should include:

Professional experience

• A minimum of five years’ progressive experience in enterprise red teaming or offensive research

• A proven track record of web application pentesting with an emphasis on remediation and hardening

• Experience defining and driving product roadmaps for red team tools (not required, but highly valued)

• Demonstrated ability to evaluate complex technology stacks, including common cloud platforms (M365/Azure, Google, or AWS), CI/CD pipelines, and AI-powered platforms and systems

• Experience communicating technical findings to non-technical stakeholders and the ability to bring technical assessments to life

Technical competencies

• Familiarity with both Mitre and OWASP frameworks, and experience applying them in client reporting

• Relevant security certifications (e.g., OSCP, OSCE, OSEP, GIAC GPEN/GXPN, etc.) are a plus, indicating solid foundational knowledge and commitment to the offensive security field.

• Prior experience developing agent-specific attack types such as prompt injection, memory & context poisoning, or jailbreaking

• A working understanding of MCP, LLM pipelines, the functional aspects of LLMs, and how modern agent solutions are integrated with widely used cloud suites such as M365 or AWS

Finally, experience in intermediate to advanced vulnerability research related to applications or operating systems will be considered a strong plus, but is not a requirement for this role.

What we offer

On top of a competitive salary and bonus package, we offer you the opportunity to join a unique team of experts and enthusiasts in your field. Our expectations are matched by our willingness to invest in your development – whether through training, conferences, or the opportunity to pursue research in areas you’re passionate about.

We combine remote work with meaningful co-working at our offices in Copenhagen and will provide you with the tooling and hardware required to reach our goal of building a unique red team platform.

For questions or enquiries, feel free to contact Anders Rømer Skøtt at anrs@thetechcollective.eu // +45 31717487.

jobs.occupation: Transformation Analyst
jobs.description:
Turn strategy into action. Turn data into decisions. Help deliver SGL’s most important agenda.

Are you ready to help shape SGL’s next chapter?

Scan Global Logistics is entering a decisive phase. Our strategy and major initiatives are in place. The priority now is to convert ambition into disciplined execution, measurable results and lasting change across our global organisation.

We are therefore looking for an exceptional Transformation Analyst to join the Chief Transformation Office. This is not a traditional reporting or PMO role. You will become a trusted analytical partner to the Chief Transformation Officer and help run the enterprise execution system behind SGL’s transformation agenda.

You will work close to the decisions that matter, with direct exposure to executive leadership, regional and functional leaders, and selected representatives of our private equity owners. Your analysis will help determine priorities, challenge assumptions, resolve performance gaps and accelerate value realisation.

The role is ideal for a highly analytical, commercially minded individual who wants exceptional responsibility, visibility and development potential early in their career.

What you can expect

• A front-row seat to one of SGL’s highest-priority enterprise agendas, spanning strategy execution, operating performance, integration, shared services, AI-enabled transformation and organisational development.

• Direct reporting to the Chief Transformation Officer and frequent interaction with SGL’s senior leaders across functions, regions and countries.

• Exposure to our private equity owners and preparation of fact-based insights for executive, owner and Board-level discussions.

• A steep learning curve with room to grow into broader transformation, strategy, programme or leadership responsibilities.

• A global, entrepreneurial environment where pace is high, decisions matter and strong ideas are expected to translate into action.

Your role

You will combine rigorous analysis with hands-on execution support. You will not only describe what is happening. You will help establish what should happen next, who owns it and how SGL follows through.

Portfolio intelligence and executive insight

• Maintain a clear, fact-based view of the enterprise transformation portfolio, including priorities, milestones, interdependencies, resources, risks and decisions required.

• Integrate financial, operational and initiative data into concise insights and recommendations for the Chief Transformation Officer and senior stakeholders.

• Identify emerging performance gaps, challenge underlying assumptions and translate complex information into clear choices and actions.

• Prepare high-quality dashboards, decision papers and materials for executive leadership, owner and Board-level discussions.

Value realisation and performance management

• Build and challenge business cases, baselines, targets and benefit logic for major transformation initiatives.

• Track value delivery against plan and work with Finance and initiative owners to strengthen data quality, accountability and transparency.

• Perform variance, productivity, cost, cash and operational analyses and turn findings into practical actions.

• Help create one source of truth for transformation performance and ensure that reporting supports decisions rather than administration.

Execution and transformation support

• Support the governance and operating cadence across the transformation agenda, including preparation, action tracking, escalation and decision follow-through.

• Work directly with initiative owners and regional or functional leaders to clarify plans, unblock issues and strengthen execution discipline.

• Analyse cross-functional dependencies and capacity constraints and propose pragmatic sequencing or trade-offs.

• Take ownership of selected high-priority analyses and workstreams from problem definition through recommendation and implementation follow-up.

Chief Transformation Officer support

• Act as a trusted analytical partner to the Chief Transformation Officer on priority topics, stakeholder discussions and rapid-response assignments.

• Help connect the strategy, the transformation portfolio and the performance agenda into one coherent executive view.

• Contribute to communication of priorities, progress and the case for change across SGL.

• Bring energy, intellectual curiosity and constructive challenge to a small team with a broad enterprise mandate.

Who we are looking for

We are looking for someone with unusual analytical strength and the ambition to become a transformation leader. You combine precision and structure with business judgment, curiosity and the confidence to engage senior stakeholders.

• 5+ years of high-performance experience from management consulting, corporate strategy, transformation, transaction services, FP&A, business intelligence or a similar analytical environment.

• Advanced analytical and financial modelling skills, including the ability to build business cases, interpret operational performance and test value-creation assumptions.

• Excellent PowerPoint and Excel capabilities; experience with Power BI, Power Apps or other visualization tools is an advantage.

What will make you successful

• You take ownership and deliver high-quality work at pace.

• You are intellectually rigorous without making simple issues complicated.

• You challenge constructively and remain pragmatic about what it takes to deliver in an operating business.

• You build credibility through facts, follow-through and strong stakeholder relationships.

• You are motivated by impact, learning and the opportunity to help shape a developing function.

Why join Scan Global Logistics?

At SGL, you will join an international logistics company with an entrepreneurial culture, high ambitions and a strong belief that results are created by people who take responsibility. Our DNA is built on Respect, Integrity, Entrepreneurship & Fun.

This role offers a rare combination of analytical depth, senior exposure and practical influence. You will help build the capabilities, governance and insight required to turn SGL’s ambitions into measurable value, while developing your own career alongside the agenda.

The transformation agenda is not a side project. It is a central priority for SGL, and this role will be at the heart of making it happen.

Interested?

Send your CV and application through the SGL career portal. We review applications on an ongoing basis and will close the process when the right candidate has been found.

For further information, please contact Nikolaj Lei Jacobsen, Chief Transformation Officer , +45 5339 2364 or visit www.scangl.com.

Scan Global Logistics is a Global full-service logistics provider headquartered in the Nordic, who excel in uncomplicating logistics through tailored solutions made by skilled specialists, proud problem-solvers and passionate entrepreneurs.

Since 1975, the core of our DNA has been a ‘can-do-attitude’, agility and the willingness to always go the extra mile and we are not afraid to go left when others go right. For us, every challenge is an opportunity. We go above and beyond to bring anything to anywhere – whether by road, rail, ocean, air or any other modes of transportation.

jobs.occupation: Senior Management Consultant - Copenhagen
jobs.description:
At Efficio, we're not just a consulting firm; we're a team of dedicated experts committed to transforming procurement and supply chain functions. Our mission is to drive sustainable, measurable value for our clients through innovative solutions and deep industry insights. Join us and be part of a dynamic environment where your skills and ideas make a real impact.

Efficio is the world’s largest specialist procurement and supply chain consultancy, with offices across Europe, North America, and the Middle East. We’re a diverse team of over 1,300 individuals, representing more than 60 different nationalities and speaking 40+ languages – and we’re continuing to grow rapidly!

We are recruiting for our Nordics region where you'll be joining a growing team of nearly 30 people supporting clients across the Nordics and across Europe. Our consultants provide flexible support to clients whether it is a rapid assessment, short term savings realisation or embedding in a long-term partnership to deliver lasting and measurable value to clients.

**As a Senior Consultant (SC), you will have complete ownership of complex workstreams or several smaller workstreams and be supported by junior resources. You should be deemed as a subject matter expert (SME) both internally and by clients and you will be responsible for the following:

**

• Managing complex workstreams or multiple smaller workstreams. Often supported by junior resources

• Managing more junior consultants on projects, making sure Efficio methodologies and processes are followed

• Driving complex analysis where data is hard to access and using expertise to creatively develop conclusions and recommended solutions

• Playing a role in advising clients and designing solutions that address complex needs, achieve sustainable results, and demonstrate real impact

• Effectively managing and owning the relationship with senior stakeholders

• Planning and preparing documentation for own workstream

• Taking part in the recruitment process of potential junior consultants

Our collaborative and inclusive culture is what makes us stand out. At Efficio, colleagues with diverse backgrounds, ideas, and viewpoints come together to identify innovative solutions for our clients - and so we're looking for our new team members to bring strong communication, empathy, and relationship-building skills to maintain this culture as we grow.

We encourage our teams to proactively innovate and challenge the status-quo, backed by strong analytical thinking and creative problem-solving abilities alongside comfortable proficiency in Excel and PowerPoint. We're looking for team members who enjoy and have experience of digging into complex challenges at a leading management consultancy or in a relevant industry position.

Strong opportunities for career growth are an important part of our offering; as such, we love seeing ambition and a proactive approach to shaping your career to your goals and interests.

To meet client needs, we look for flexibility to travel; you can give us a heads-up on your preferences when applying.

We'd love to hear about any additional skills or experiences you bring to the table. We're particularly interested in:

• Fluency in both English and a Nordic language

• Management consulting experience within a leading consultancy, ideally within procurement and/or supply chain

• Experience (or an interest) in strategic sourcing, procurement transformation, supply chain, operations, infrastructure, or capital projects

• Proven track record of working closely with senior client stakeholders

• Deep analytical skills and problem-solving skills, with the ability to isolate key issues and draw sound conclusions

• Strong grasp of detail and a 'hands-on' approach

• Excellent interpersonal and leadership skills

• Ability to confidently improve existing ways of working, recognize opportunities and identify innovative solutions that add real value to clients

We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

jobs.occupation: Senior Manager, Process Management & Excellence, Procurement
jobs.description:
**Location: Taastrup, Denmark

**Are you an experienced leader who can bring clarity and direction in a complex and changing environment? Can you empower highly capable specialists while creating the structure and boundaries that enable them to perform at their best? And are you comfortable influencing senior stakeholders, challenging constructively and shaping how an organisation operates?If you are motivated by leading through transformation rather than simply maintaining established processes, this could be your opportunity to help shape the next chapter of Global Direct Procurement at Novo.

**The position

**As Senior Manager, Process Management & Excellence, you will lead a newly established team within Procurement Solutions, part of Global Direct Procurement.Following the recent evolution of the organisation, your initial challenge will be to bring together a highly capable group of professionals, establish a clear operating model and create alignment around the team's purpose, priorities and ways of working.

This is not a traditional operational people-management role. Your team brings significant subject matter expertise and is capable of operating with a high degree of independence. Your role will be to provide direction, create the conditions in which they can succeed and ensure their expertise is focused on the areas that create the greatest impact for the wider organisation.

Operating across an organisation of approximately 200 colleagues, you will also act as a senior delegate and sparring partner to the Director of Procurement Solutions. You will work independently with senior stakeholders, helping translate changing organisational needs into clear priorities while establishing appropriate expectations and boundaries for the team.

**Your Key Responsibilities Will Include

**

• Leading, coaching and developing a team of professionals with different levels of seniority, creating clear expectations while empowering them to operate independently.

• Establishing and continuously developing the team's operating model, mandate, priorities and ways of working.

• Creating clarity around roles, responsibilities and interfaces following organisational change.

• Acting as a senior sparring partner and delegate for the Director of Procurement Solutions and representing the team with senior stakeholders.

• Influencing and challenging stakeholders across Global Direct Procurement and connected functions, ensuring priorities and expectations remain aligned.

• Driving process excellence and transformation across purchase planning and related procurement processes.

• Setting direction across areas including risk, cost and budget processes, sourcing activities, analytics, performance management, inventory and scrap.

• Translating complex or changing business requirements into clear priorities and practical action.

• Supporting fact-based senior decision-making, including recommendations on priorities, trade offs, resources, risks and business impact.

• Building an engaged and aligned team with a strong sense of collective purpose, accountability and performance.

**About The Department

**Global Direct Procurement is responsible for end-to-end procurement strategy and execution for direct materials and services supporting Novo's global manufacturing network. The organisation is strengthening global scale, standardisation, cross-regional collaboration and transparency across procurement activities.

Procurement Solutions is one of the business functions within Global Direct Procurement. It brings together specialist capabilities in business partnering, project management, process management, analytics, planning excellence and risk management.

The Process Management & Excellence team works across the wider organisation, supporting strategically important processes and priorities. As the organisation continues to evolve, the team has an important role in creating greater clarity, consistency, performance and transparency across Global Direct Procurement.

You will collaborate closely with colleagues across category management, strategic sourcing, supplier operations, digital procurement, finance, supply chain and risk.

**Your Skills And Qualifications

**We are looking for an experienced, structured and independent people leader who can create followership in a complex stakeholder landscape. You combine strategic ownership with pragmatic execution and are motivated by building a team that helps the wider business perform better.

**We Expect That You Have

**

• A master's degree or equivalent within business administration, supply chain, engineering, economics or another relevant field.

• Significant experience from procurement, supply chain, sourcing, process excellence, operational excellence, business transformation or a related area within a complex international environment.

• Proven people leadership experience with professionals with different levels of seniority.

• Demonstrated experience owning a functional agenda, operating model, governance structure or transformation roadmap beyond pure execution.

• Experience driving cross-functional process improvements, analytics, planning excellence or implementation of process solutions.

• An understanding of direct procurement value chains and experience in areas such as sourcing, risk management, planning, budgeting, performance management or business case development.

• Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills, with the ability to influence, challenge and build alignment across seniority levels and functions.

• Fluency in written and spoken English.

Direct procurement expertise would be valuable, but it is not the only route into this position. We are equally interested in leaders from areas such as supply chain, operational excellence or business transformation who can demonstrate strong people leadership and experience shaping organisations through change.

As a person, you create clarity in ambiguity and make fact-based recommendations. You are comfortable taking ownership and challenging constructively, while empowering talented specialists to operate independently. You combine collaboration and inclusion with the judgement and resilience required to establish boundaries, make decisions and maintain focus in a changing environment.

**Why Novo

**At Novo, we don’t wait for change. We drive it. We’re a dynamic company in an even more dynamic industry, and we know that what got us to where we are today is not necessarily what will make us successful in the future. We embrace the spirit of experimentation, striving for excellence without fixating on perfection. We never shy away from opportunities to develop; we seize them. From research and development to manufacturing, marketing, and sales we’re all working to move the needle on patient care.

**Working at Novo

**Every day we seek the solutions that defeat serious chronic diseases. To do this, we approach our work with determination, constant curiosity and a commitment to finding better ways forward. For over 100 years, this dedication has driven us to build a company focused on lasting change for long term health. One where diverse thinking, shared purpose and mutual respect come together to create extraordinary results. When you join us, you are not just starting a job – you are becoming part of a story that spans generations.

Salary and benefitsThe salary range for this position is DKK 742,600 to 1,091,600 per year, depending on experience and qualifications.

**Incentives And Benefits

**Novo offers a competitive compensation package, including pension, bonus opportunities and a range of employee benefits designed to support your professional and personal wellbeing.

**What We Offer

**There is, of course, more on offer here than the unique opportunity to work at a global healthcare company. We offer you the chance to make a difference in the lives of millions of people living with serious chronic diseases. In addition, you will have access to opportunities for professional development and career progression in an international organisation.

We need to aspire to be the best company for the world and we know that this is only possible with talented employees with diverse perspectives, backgrounds and cultures. We are therefore committed to creating an inclusive culture that celebrates the diversity of our employees, the patients we serve and communities we operate in. Together, we're life changing.

We commit to an inclusive recruitment process and equality of opportunity for all our job applicants.

jobs.occupation: Internship at CERTA Intelligence & Security
jobs.description:
An internship at CERTA Intelligence & Security will give you the opportunity to gain insight into the work of identifying, preventing, and addressing security threats and risks that affect the activities, employees, and reputation of private corporations.

At the same time, the internship will allow you to test your skills in an environment of researchers, analysts, and advisors with experience from, among other places, national intelligence and security services.

As an intern at CERTA, you will be an integral part of the team you are assigned to and will be given a supervisor. The specific tasks you will be responsible for will vary depending on the team you join.

CERTA offers ongoing internships in each of the following areas:

• Intelligence collection and analysis

• Security consulting

Duration and Application Deadlines

We are looking for interns twice a year, and the internship lasts for six months:

• Spring (February 1st – July 31st)

• Application period is October 15th to November 15th the previous year

• Autumn (August 1st – January 31st)

• Application period is April 15th to May 15th

Requirements

You must be a student enrolled in a higher education institution at the bachelor’s or master’s level. Your application should specify whether the internship can be credited toward your degree and if you will receive student grants (SU) during the internship.

It is not a requirement that you are a Danish citizen or that you speak and write Danish fluently, although it may be beneficial if you understand Danish to some extent.

Qualifications

We are looking for students with strong analytical skills and methodological abilities, dedication, as well as a curious, open, and positive approach to problem-solving. Please include good examples of these qualifications in your application. Additionally, we expect you to have good English skills and preferably knowledge of other languages, as well as being IT proficient, including familiarity with the MS Office suite (PowerPoint, Excel, and Word).

The internship should contribute to your education and will take place under the guidance of an academic staff member at CERTA Intelligence & Security. We recommend that you check in advance what academic requirements your educational institution has regarding an internship.

Vacation and Working Hours

The average working hours are 37 hours per week (excluding lunch break). You will accrue 2.08 vacation days for each month of your internship, totalling 12.5 days during your 6-month internship. If your study program requires you to write a major academic assignment in connection with your internship, you may also receive writing leave of up to 10 days, depending on the scope and complexity of the assignment.

Application

You can apply for an internship at CERTA Intelligence & Security by submitting a written and motivated application to internship@certaintelligence.com during the application period. When applying for an intern position, you must include your CV along with your diploma/grades. You may also choose to attach other relevant documents, such as references from employers or educational institutions.

Your motivated application should be written in English and not exceed one page, and it should include a description of why you want an internship, what you hope to gain from the internship, and what relevant experience and skills you have for the specific intern position.

It should be clearly stated in your application which area (“Intelligence collection and analysis” or “Security consulting”) you are applying for an intern position.

jobs.occupation: PhD scholarship in Arctic fjord food webs under glacial retreat - DTU Aqua
jobs.description:
Greenland Institute of Natural Resources (GINR), the Greenland Climate Research Centre (GCRC) and DTU Aqua invite applications for a joint PhD position investigating how glacial retreat affect the structure, functioning, and stability of Arctic fjord food webs.

The position offers an excellent opportunity to combine Arctic field ecology, laboratory analyses, quantitative trophic ecology, and ecosystem modelling while working in Greenland and Denmark. You will become part of an interdisciplinary research environment spanning GINR, DTU Aqua, and the wider EDGE project.

The PhD project focuses on two contrasting fjord systems near Nuuk, Greenland, which differ in their degree of glacial influence. It is part of the Independent Research Fund Denmark project “Fjords on the EDGE: Resilience of Greenland Coastal Food Webs in a Warming Arctic”.

The overall aim is to understand how changes at the glacier–ocean interface propagates through the coastal ecosystem, from primary production to benthic communities, fish, and marine mammals. In particular, you will investigate the relative importance of benthic and pelagic energy pathways for key consumers using stable isotope analyses and stomach-content data. These observations will be integrated into an ecosystem model to explore how deglaciation tipping points may alter food-web structure and ecosystem functioning.

The position is jointly hosted by GINR in Nuuk and DTU Aqua in Lyngby. You will be based in Nuuk during the first two years and at DTU Aqua in Lyngby during the final year. Fieldwork, courses, project meetings, and collaborations will take place at additional locations throughout the PhD. You will be enrolled as a PhD student at DTU Aqua and work closely with researchers at both institutions and with collaborators in the EDGE project.

Responsibilities and qualifications
Your primary responsibilities will be to:

• Conduct fieldwork in Nuup Kangerlua and Ameralik during 2027, collecting benthic and pelagic samples.
• Prepare and analyse samples for stable isotope analysis and use isotope mixing models to quantify the relative contribution of benthic and pelagic food sources to key consumers.
• Conduct fish stomach-content analyses to characterise diets and trophic interactions.
• Integrate new observations with existing datasets to develop and parameterise an ecosystem model based on the StratE2E framework.
• Use the model to investigate how glacial retreat and associated changes in pelagic production may affect fjord food-web structure, functioning, and stability.
• Publish results in international peer-reviewed journals and present findings at scientific conferences and to relevant local stakeholders.
We are looking for a highly motivated candidate with a strong interest in Arctic marine ecosystems and interdisciplinary research. You should have:

• A two-year master’s degree (120 ECTS) in marine biology, marine ecology, fisheries science, ecosystem modelling, or a related field, with good academic results.
• A strong interest in fieldwork and laboratory-based research, including the ability to work effectively on ocean-going research vessels in Arctic environments.
• Demonstrated experience with quantitative data analysis and scientific programming in R, Python, or MATLAB.
• Knowledge of marine ecosystem dynamics and trophic or food-web ecology.
• Strong analytical and scientific communication skills.
• Fluency in written and spoken English.
The following qualifications are considered an advantage:

• Experience with ecological or ecosystem modelling, including StratE2E or similar frameworks.
• Experience with stable isotope ecology and/or mixing models.
• Experience identifying benthic organisms.
• Experience with fish diet or stomach-content analyses.
• Experience with Arctic marine ecosystems.
• A published or submitted peer-reviewed scientific publication.
• Fluency in Danish and Greenlandic.
We recognise that candidates may bring different combinations of these skills and do not expect applicants to have prior experience in all components of the project. Particular emphasis will be placed on scientific potential.

You must have a two-year master's degree (120 ECTS points) or a similar degree with an academic level equivalent to a two-year master's degree.

Approval and Enrolment 
The scholarship for the PhD degree is subject to academic approval, and the candidate will be enrolled in one of the general degree programmes at DTU. For information about our enrolment requirements and the general planning of the PhD study programme, please see DTU's rules for the PhD education. 

Assessment
The assessment of the applicants will be made by Professor Teunis Jansen (DTU Aqua and GINR) and Researcher Sandra Maier (GINR).

We offer
DTU is a leading technical university globally recognized for the excellence of its research, education, innovation and scientific advice. We offer a rewarding and challenging job in an international environment. We strive for academic excellence in an environment characterized by collegial respect and academic freedom tempered by responsibility.

Salary and appointment terms 
The appointment will be based on the collective agreement with the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations. Please see DTU’s salary structure for scientific staff: www.inside.dtu.dk/en/human-resources/during-employment/salary/salary-structures

The position is a full-time, three-year PhD appointment administered by DTU. The expected starting date is 1 February 2027. You will be based at GINR in Nuuk during the first two years and at DTU Aqua in Lyngby during the final year. GINR will assist the successful candidate with finding accommodation in Nuuk.

You can read more about career paths at DTU here.

Further information
For further information, please contact Professor Teunis Jansen, DTU Aqua and GINR (tej@aqua.dtu.dk), or Researcher Sandra Maier, GINR (sama@natur.gl)

If you are applying from abroad, you may find useful information on working in Denmark and at DTU at DTU – Moving to Denmark. Furthermore, you have the option of joining our monthly free seminar “PhD relocation to Denmark and startup “Zoom” seminar” for all questions regarding the practical matters of moving to Denmark and working as a PhD at DTU. 

Application procedure 
Your complete online application must be submitted no later than 30 November 2026 (23:59 Danish time). 

Applications must be submitted as one PDF file containing all materials to be given consideration. To apply, please open the link "Apply now", fill out the online application form, and attach all your materials in English in one PDF file. The file must include:

• A letter motivating the application (cover letter)
• Curriculum vitae 
• Grade transcripts and BSc/MSc diploma (in English) including official description of grading scale
You may apply prior to obtaining your master's degree but cannot begin before having received it. 

Applications received after the deadline will not be considered.

All interested candidates irrespective of age, gender, disability, race, religion or ethnic background are encouraged to apply. As DTU works with research in critical technology, which is subject to special rules for security and export control, open-source background checks may be conducted on qualified candidates for the position.

About DTU Aqua
DTU Aqua – National Institute of Aquatic Resources – works for well-functioning oceans, rivers, and lakes where biodiversity can thrive. Our research, advisory service, and education contribute to the development of a sustainable blue bioeconomy, robust aquatic ecosystems, and reduced effects of climate change. We have a large national and international network and cooperate with research partners, public authorities, industry, and NGOs. We have state-of-the-art research facilities and Denmark’s only ocean- and arctic-going research vessel. The Institute has about 400 employees, one-half being scientific staff, including about 45 PhD students. About 40 nationalities are represented at the institute, and we support an equal gender distribution. We are located in Lyngby, Hirtshals, Nykøbing Mors, and Silkeborg and have regular activities in Greenland. Learn more on aqua.dtu.dk

DTU – For the benefit of society since 1829
DTU is one of Europe's leading elite technical universities. Through research and education at an international top level, we create solutions to the major societal challenges of our time and help secure Europe's global leadership in sustainable technological development. Since Hans Christian Ørsted founded DTU almost 200 years ago, our mission has remained the same: We develop and create value through the natural and technical sciences for the benefit of society. DTU has 13,800 students, 1,600 PhD students, and 6,500 employees. We work in an international environment and have an inclusive, stimulating, and informal work culture. DTU has campuses in all parts of Denmark and in Greenland and collaborates with the best universities around the world.

• Experience from regulated industries such as Life Sciences, Financial Services, Tax Administration, or Defence is an advantage

• A collaborative mindset with a passion for solving complex challenges and creating impact together with clients and colleagues

Why join Valcon?

At Valcon, you’ll become part of a collaborative and welcoming community where knowledge sharing, continuous learning, and professional development are a natural part of everyday life. We offer exciting projects, a transparent career framework, certification opportunities, and strong support for your professional growth. We also believe that great work happens when people thrive, which is why we place a strong emphasis on flexibility, well-being, and family-friendly benefits. Beyond our client work, our community comes together through both professional and social activities, creating an environment where people can build meaningful relationships and feel a sense of belonging.

Interested?

We are looking for talented professionals who are excited by this opportunity and can contribute to our team. While you may not meet every requirement, you should bring strong relevant experience and a genuine passion for data and technology. We invite candidates ongoing to interviews.

jobs.occupation: Internship in Water Ecosystem and Business Development
jobs.description:
Would you like to be part of Kamstrup Water’s business development journey, and do you have a passion for solutions that drive sustainable growth? Are you ready to get hands-on experience with Business Development while working on the digital footprint within our Water division? Do you want to kick-start your career and turn your theoretical knowledge into practical experience in an international company?

Here is what the job entails

As an intern in our Water Ecosystem and Business Development team, you will collaborate closely with experienced colleagues to shape the next generation of solutions for water utilities. Your work will focus on exploring the right technologies, markets, and potential partners during the innovation phase. This includes identifying impactful solutions, creating pilots, and generating value propositions and business cases to guide future priorities.

More specifically you will be:

• Conducting desk research to investigate competitive solutions, markets, and potential partners.

• Participating in workshops and webinars to gain insights and foster collaboration.

• Contributing to idea generation sessions with customers or stakeholders to drive innovation.

• Supporting the development of business cases for promising opportunities.

• Assisting in managing projects related to the development and implementation of new solutions.

Meet your future team

You will become a part of a department, that focuses on Business Development within Kamstrup Water business unit. The team consists of 2 dedicated employees and a student worker and is characterized by a youthful atmosphere where new ideas and sparring are the backbone of everything we do. The department is responsible for the expansion and growth of future solutions in the water solutions portfolio on a global scale.

Less about us, more about you

We are looking for an analytical-minded student who strives to create valuable commercial impact on our Water business unit. You have a commercial focus combined with a solution orientation mindset which empowers you to translate customer challenges into solutions.

In order to succeed, we imagine that you:

• Are studying Global Business Engineering, Business & Water Technology, or a relevant MSc in Economics and Business Administration, Business Development, Business Management, Digital Business Management, or similar. That being said, there are many entry points to this position

• As a person have a curious and creative mindset, allowing you to proactively seek new knowledge and thereby provide new ideas and challenge status quo

• Have a structured approach to your work, enabling you to manage several ongoing tasks while maintaining an overview

• Naturally strive towards ensuring quality results whether you are collaborating with colleagues or working independently

As we are an international organisation it is important that you are fluent in English.

Whilst you may not meet all the qualifications listed above, this is an internship position, and we value curiosity and a willingness to learn just as much as experience. If the role interests you and you are motivated to grow, we encourage you to apply.

We offer more than just an internship

At Kamstrup, your contribution as an intern is highly valued, and we cherish the good colleagueship. Therefore, you will experience an internship with a strong focus on your individual development through challenging tasks, career sparring, voluntary courses, as well as social events and a large network. We are proud, that our internship program has resulted in Studenterhus Aarhus granting us with the Mentor Award, the Internationalization Award, the Jury’s Special Award and the award for East Jutland’s Best Internship.

Besides the best program, we also offer:

• A gratuity which may be provided in recognition of your efforts if your place of study allows it as well as paid public transportation to and from work

• Multiple internship events and weekly internship lunches

• Employee benefits including a healthy canteen, fitness facilities, in-house dental clinic, hairdresser, and a free health clinic

• An active employee association, that fosters a collaborative and supportive workplace community

Do you want to be a part of Kamstrup?

The applications are reviewed on a continuous basis, but you can expect a response within six weeks. Any details about the internship will be individually agreed upon. However, the internship is expected to run from the beginning of February 2027 until the end of June 2027.

Kamstrup is located in Stilling south of Aarhus, and bus number 200 takes you right to the door.

If you have any questions about the position, please contact Business Development Manager, Amalie Lund, on telephone nr.: +45 89 93 10 00.

jobs.occupation: Product Engineer
jobs.description:
At Complir we are building the system to enable safer physical products being sold across markets. The world of product compliance has been stuck in legacy systems, excel sheets and the brains of experts. The increasing amount of regulations and complexity is breaking these old systems, making it increasingly hard to sell safe compliant products to consumers. We are building the product that enables compliance experts to stay afloat.

We are a small team of generalists working on all parts of the stack. One day you might be working on improving the reliability of our AI systems, another you might be tweaking the UI of the product. Our team is one of high trust, collaboration and autonomy, therefore we’re looking for engineers who thrive when given responsibility from day one and are not afraid to figure out things on their own. We ship early and iterate directly with customers, therefore you will be expected to be comfortable talking directly to the users using the software you will build.

****Location

****Our office is located in Copenhagen and you will be expected to work in person. We will provide the necessary help with relocation if needed.

****Day to day at Complir

• You will be working directly with the founders, customers and our in house specialists and you will help figure out what needs to be built

• Build AI native software that integrates with the latest models to solve our customers' hardest problems. (we have plenty of tokens)

• Build durable workflows to understand customers' unstructured data.

• Improve the data structures that connects cross border regulatory data

• Surface novel insights from unstructured and structured data

****What we’re looking for

• At least 2-5 years of experience

• Strong understanding of React and TypeScript, with experience of working across the full stack. You understand browsers, but also the ins and outs of databases

• Product taste. You have opinions about UI/UX and enjoy iterating to get to the correct product shape

• High agency. You take responsibility and are able to work without a PM giving you tickets

• Experience working at a startup

****What we offer

• Small collaborative team. We work hard but have a lot of fun. We are a diverse set of people with different backgrounds

• Employee friendly equity package

• Competitive salary

• Work at a venture backed startup. Read our latest 11m seed round led by GC here: https://www.complir.io/resources/news/complir-raises-11m-seed

• Assistance with relocation if need be

• 0 -> 1 work. Have real influence on how the product is shaped and work on green field projects

jobs.occupation: Senior AI Engineer (Machine Learning)
jobs.description:
At GetWhy, we’re on a mission to change the way brands understand people. We help the world's biggest brands get closer to their consumers—faster, smarter, and with a human touch - through breakthrough research powered by AI. Companies like Coca-Cola, Heineken, Unilever and more trust us to deliver consumer insights in hours, not weeks.

We are building an end-to-end AI-powered human insights platform, redefining the boundaries of qualitative research. To fuel our journey, we raised a $34.5M Series A investment from PeakSpan Capital in 2024, making it one of Denmark’s largest Series A rounds to date.

What the AI team does

We are dedicated to delivering high-quality AI products leveraging the latest tools and techniques and to serve them across our core products in a scalable way.

For this, we use classic machine learning for predictive models to deal with fraud detection, language classification, visual understanding and automating internal workflows. These make heavy use of video processing, speech-to-text and multilingual translations models and pipelines.

We also build a lot of functionality around state of the art LLMs. We treat off-the-shelf LLMs as future commodities and aim to benefit from their strengths while employing principled methodologies to build guardrails and fallback strategies for their weaknesses. We strive to achieve a deep understanding of prompt engineering, context management, and LLM behavior quirks (e.g., hallucinations, non-determinism, context management), by focusing on evaluation and observability through monitoring for latency, accuracy, and usage.

Who you are

We’re looking for a Senior AI Engineer to join our growing stellar AI team. You will be responsible for all stages in the machine learning lifecycles across projects, from designing and defining data annotation steps to model training, validation and deployment.

**More Specifically, You Should Have These Minimum Qualifications

**

• At least 5+ years developing machine learning systems, in particular NLP models.

• Proficiency in Python, along with a solid understanding of data structures and algorithms, and the capability to write production-quality code.

• Significant experience working with LLMs at scale, Prompt Engineering and AI Agents.

• Solid understanding of LLM evaluation, dealing with hallucinations, inconsistent outputs, context management, conversational AI and voice technologies, including text-to-speech.

• Proven experience formulating hypotheses, conducting experiments, and analyzing results.

• Exceptional English skills, both spoken and in writing.

What you will do

• Build AI-powered features at scale using the latest advancements in LLMs.

• Research, prototype, and build advanced NLP/ML models to enable automated resolution of end-user problems.

• Design and conduct rigorous experiments and evaluations to enhance model accuracy and reliability.

• Refine prompts and tune hyper-parameters to maximize the performance of cutting-edge retrieval and generative AI systems.

• Work closely with researchers, engineers, and product teams to define feature scope and implementation strategies.

• Mentor junior team members and engage in collaborative learning with peers to promote knowledge sharing.

• Contribute to technical reviews and share expertise in ML methodologies and best practices

• Writing clean, maintainable, and well-structured code to meet delivery goals.

What we offer

• A highly ambitious AI team driven by sky-is-the-limit long term vision and goals, while working to identify and deliver intermediate milestones.

• A full-time position with a competitive salary plus benefits.

• A flexible work schedule with opportunities to work from home.

• A vibrant and international work environment with 60+ colleagues from 15+ nationalities.

• A modern, newly renovated Nordhavnen office with stunning waterfront views, office lunch, relaxation areas, gym, free daily energizers, snacks, and drinks.

• A company culture that values innovation, collaboration, and transparency.

• Annual company retreats and Friday bar events – we work hard, we celebrate hard.

How do I apply?

Click on the apply button and upload your resumé or LinkedIn profile. If we see a potential match, we’ll invite you for a conversation at our office to get to know you better and share more about our culture and this opportunity.

So, what are you waiting for? Hit the apply button and come join the next Danish unicorn.
